name: What proof should I ask for before hiring someone to install my kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What proof should I ask for before hiring someone to install my kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ask for a written estimate that breaks out cabinets, installation labor, hardware, delivery, demo, and any disposal fees. You should also ask for photos of similar projects so you can judge the installer’s work quality, not just the price.
acceptedAnswer.description: Request a detailed written estimate and recent photos of completed projects. That shows what is included and whether the installer’s work matches your expectations.
